target: Linux aarch64 ARMv8-A; Ubuntu 22.04; Jetson R36.5.0; OpenCV 4.8.0 .so.408
notes: The first combined bridge test was rejected by the unchanged startup clock guard during host scheduling stalls (p95 2.418 ms, max 292.240 ms); the isolated rerun passed. See native_regression.log and bridge_replay.log.

Native Atlas tests use synthetic geometry and a fixture already marked mature. Production code does not force initialization; these tests do not establish first-time physical initialization or absolute accuracy.

IMU state recovery recomputes velocity and biases from fresh visual poses and IMU measurements. Recovery gates and uncertainty floors are engineering approximations, not a statistical accuracy certificate.
Visual map reuse needs sufficient visible old-map features. It cannot guarantee drift-free estimates under complete occlusion or rapid shaking.
The inherited +16881057 ns time shift was calibrated on C; B physical timing remains to be independently validated.
The source copy and package are prepared on this Mac. No deployment or hardware run was performed on Jetson.
